correctness.rationale: Rank<=1 inducing maps factor through FBL^(p)[real one-space], which has dimension two, hence induced finite rank. For rank-two S on a real two-space G, the published FBL^(p)[G] lattice-isomorphism with C(S_G*) and the explicit test-family p-norm allow disjoint continuous dual-sphere bumps with norm <=(1-eta)^-1, weakly null under the equivalent norm. Every compact approximant vanishes on them, while evaluation of induced S at dual directions approaching a norming functional gives output at least ||S||. Limit eta->0 gives essential norm ||S||, including p=infinity. Two-dimensional near-norm-attaining restrictions and functoriality extend to arbitrary E,F. Essential norm <=operator norm gives equality; approximation numbers and discontinuity example follow. No order density of an infinite-dimensional free lattice is needed.
residual_risks: Reproducible finite checks and existing verification logs never prove unbounded theorems; the above analytic argument supplies the proof.
